The '''''Ewok Festival of Love''''' were a series of paintings made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. There were two versions of the paintings: one depicted two Ewoks (a brown Ewok and a white Ewok) embracing each other in the forests of Endor, and the other was a purple-toned painting depicting a green ribbon with red and blue dots, an Ewok cub, and Aurebesh writing. Both were sold during festivities of the titular annual event, the [[Festival of Love|Ewok Festival of Love]].

==Behind the scenes==
The painting(s) were available for the Festival of Love events, where they could be purchased for eight chak hearts. After game update 10, they were labeled as a non share trade item. By Ewok Festival of Love 2010, the painting was given a different design.
